target_customer: Restaurants wanting to add delivery and pick-up volume through virtual brands operated from shared kitchens
problem: Restaurants struggle to reach delivery customers and operate delivery efficiently.
business_model: Licensed virtual brands cooked and delivered from staffed shared kitchens, taking a share of sales
product_category: Virtual restaurant and ghost kitchen operator

founders.name: Chen-Chen Huo
founders.background_notes: YC page describes a hospitality background and part time bar ownership.

founders.name: Antony Bello
founders.background_notes: Listed as a founder on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Operating kitchens, ordering and delivery logistics across several brands is operationally hard but uses standard technology.

defensibility.rationale: Brands and kitchens were easy to copy and delivery platforms controlled demand.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Delivery platforms and well funded kitchen companies entered the same space in 2018 and 2019; Purple Plate went inactive.

market_need_then: Delivery demand was growing and restaurants sought incremental volume; dated evidence for Purple Plate specifically was not found.

branding.domain_note: Used purpleplate.co, not the .com; the host did not resolve from this environment.

identity.visual_style: Purple as the brand color implied by the name; not described in a source.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand found; the venture's product was other restaurants' brands.

outcome_analysis: Purple Plate ran staffed virtual kitchens for licensed restaurant brands and grew to 45 people by the time of its YC listing. YC marks it inactive and no shutdown story is public. A single auto generated profile attributes struggles to unit economics, which is tentative and unverified.
notes: The 150K convertible note rests on CB Insights seen in search results only (the page returned 403 on fetch) and its January 1, 2018 date looks like a placeholder, so only the year is recorded. CB Insights lists Local Kitchens, WoodSpoon and Boka Restaurant Group as competitors but with no dates, so they are not listed. Zuul, Kitchen United and DoorDash Kitchens appeared in 2019 to 2020 pieces, not sourced near the batch. Website did not resolve. CB Insights still shows the company active, conflicting with YC.
